Dear Sir/Madam, 
Pursuant to Regulation 30 of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) 
Regulations, 2015, we wish to inform you that the Yaan Enterprises Limited (“The Company”) 
has received a purchase order for the supply of yellow maize approx. value of Rs. 15.86 Crores. 
The details required in SEBI Master Circular HO/49/14/14(7)2025-CFD-POD2/1/3762/2026 
dated January 30, 2026 is enclosed in Annexure. 
You are requested to take the above information on record. 
Thanking You
